title: Input v-model reset to default value after all browser resources loaded
body:

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/github/anton-chernianu/nuxt3-issue?file=app.vue

### Describe the bug



- user loads a page with a slow internet connection
- starts entering some values ​​into the input with v-model
- after all browser resources loaded - input v-model reset to default value
